summary: Frontend-only bounded regression executed on preview URL for mobile details/summary behavior. Core regression confirmed: seven collapsible sections are not collapsed by default on fresh mobile load, and desktop resize does not force all seven open.

ui_bugs.issue: Fresh mobile load at 390 and 320 shows all 7 details open instead of collapsed by default.
After resizing 390->1440, desktop remains partially open (2/7) instead of fully expanded 7/7.

integration_issues.issue: Reproduced exact smoke issue: start at 1920 shows 7 open, resize to 390 still 7 open (expected 0).

action_items: Fix mobile initial state so <=767 starts with 0/7 open without manual interaction.
Fix matchMedia mode sync so >=768 always forces 7/7 open and hides summaries.
Re-verify collapsed-vs-open document height reduction after initial-state fix (currently 0px reduction because mobile starts fully open).
After fix, rerun full anchor/hash checks from true collapsed baseline.
critical_code_review_comments: useMobileSections currently does not enforce initial mobile collapse in runtime despite syncMode logic intent.
Desktop force-open contract is broken at runtime, suggesting matchMedia change handling/sync execution path is not reliably applying panel.open updates.
New disclosure testids are present and usable: landing-disclosure-*, landing-summary-*, landing-disclosure-body-* (good testability).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Exact observed counts: Fresh390 open=7/7; Fresh320 open=7/7; Desktop1920 open=7/7; 1920->390 still open=7/7. Forced-collapse test confirms click and keyboard toggles work correctly per section. From forced partial mobile state (features+pricing only), resize to 1440 remains open=2/7 (expected 7/7). Returning to 390 preserves 2/7. Hash direct load /#pricing opens pricing and scrolls near top (top~90). Hero->contact, demo->pricing, and mobile-nav award links can open target panel when starting from forced-collapsed state.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: 1) Load at desktop 1920 then resize to 390 => open stays 7. 2) Fresh mobile load at 390/320 => open stays 7. 3) Force mobile to 2 open, resize to 1440 => stays 2. Likely root cause is in useMobileSections mode-sync lifecycle (initial sync and/or matchMedia change path not applying expected panel.open transitions at runtime), not in markup/CSS. Mitigation: instrument syncMode and media change callbacks with counts, verify listener firing and details snapshot validity, then enforce a deterministic pass on mount + on breakpoint changes.
